cache_exclusion.method: For any seven-stone root X, every six-stone parent capable of producing X is X with one of its seven stones removed. Compare all seven parent D4 orbits against the complete 133-child universe of the pinned K0863 scan; then inspect the exact candidate bit in the matched child summary.

mobility.rule: A next point is legal exactly when det4(a,b,c,p) != 0 for every triple of existing stones; det4 is the integer determinant of rows [x^2+y^2,x,y,1], including collinear degeneracies.
